_note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-13; reciprocal negatives against chat-harness-tool-facts/chat-harness-memory-facts/chat-harness-guardrail-facts added 2026-07-13 per independent audit, since each of those siblings names this pack as its own near-neighbor). Positives: imperative / diagnostic / symptom / indirect phrasings across the three axes (hook-based logging/tracing, routing-accuracy measurement, background-task notification vs. polling). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: chat-harness-workflow-facts (a sibling — COMPOSING the agents that do work, not measuring/logging what they did), chat-harness-routing-facts (another sibling — the routing MECHANISM itself, a related but distinct concern from measuring its accuracy over time), chat-harness-tool-facts (whether a capability is a tool/resource/service, not whether its firing is logged), chat-harness-memory-facts (where a fact persists, not how an event is traced), chat-harness-guardrail-facts (which action-risk tier applies, not whether the tool call is observable after the fact), the llm plugin's own gateway/streaming siblings (a different topic entirely), and a genuine build/implement ask (this pack answers, it does not build).
